architecture.label: Landmark proximity
architecture.method: Gaussian distance decay Σexp(−d²/2σ²), σ 100 m, cutoff 300 m, mean of points every 40 m along the segment

architecture.label: Individual landmarks within 150 m
architecture.method: Landmark lot centroids within 150 m of the segment midpoint

nature.label: Full-structure inventory trees per km
nature.method: Trees with structure "Full" within 30 m, snapped to the nearest segment, ÷ length (80 m floor). Full is a structural inventory category and can include Dead or Unknown condition; not measured canopy shade

nature.label: Beside parkland
nature.method: Share of points 0/±20/±40 m from the centreline inside NYC Parks properties

nature.label: Living trees along segment
nature.method: Raw count behind trees per km

culture.label: Cultural venue proximity
culture.method: Gaussian distance decay, σ 150 m, cutoff 450 m: museums, galleries, theatres, arts centres, cinemas, libraries, music venues

culture.label: Cultural venues within 200 m
culture.method: Count within 200 m of the segment midpoint

quiet.label: 311 noise complaint intensity
quiet.method: Gaussian distance decay, σ 50 m, cutoff 150 m, last 12 months; fewer is better. Reporting depends on who calls 311

quiet.label: Roadway width
quiet.method: LION street width; narrower carries less through-traffic noise. N/A where NYC does not record a width

quiet.label: Noise complaints along segment
quiet.method: Complaints within 40 m, snapped to the nearest segment

spatial_comfort.label: Sidewalk surface beside the street
spatial_comfort.method: Share of points 5/8/11/14 m either side of the centreline inside planimetric sidewalk polygons (a sidewalk-width proxy). N/A on park paths and step streets

urban_vibrancy.label: Activity mix index
urban_vibrancy.method: Normalised Shannon diversity of place categories × ln(1 + places), within 150 m

urban_vibrancy.label: Places within 150 m
urban_vibrancy.method: OSM amenity, shop, tourism, leisure and historic features

urban_vibrancy.label: Category diversity
urban_vibrancy.method: Normalised Shannon entropy of those places

food_retail.label: Food & shop proximity
food_retail.method: Gaussian distance decay, σ 50 m, cutoff 150 m: restaurants, cafés, bars, fast food and all shops

food_retail.label: Food & shops per km
food_retail.method: Places within 60 m snapped to the nearest segment ÷ length (80 m floor)

food_retail.label: Food & shops along segment
food_retail.method: Raw count behind places per km

scenic_visual.label: Scenic feature proximity
scenic_visual.method: Gaussian distance decay, σ 100 m, cutoff 300 m: viewpoints, public artworks, fountains, memorials, monuments

scenic_visual.label: Scenic features within 150 m
scenic_visual.method: Count within 150 m of the segment midpoint

walkability.label: Intersections within 250 m
walkability.method: Centreline nodes joining 3+ walkable segments (streets, paths, step streets, alleys) within 250 m of the midpoint

access_safety.label: Pedestrian injury crash intensity
access_safety.method: Gaussian distance decay, σ 40 m, cutoff 120 m, crashes injuring or killing pedestrians, last 3 years; fewer is better. Not adjusted for pedestrian volume

access_safety.label: Pedestrian injury crashes within 25 m
access_safety.method: Count within 25 m of the segment, last 3 years

environment.label: Distance to expressway or ramp
environment.method: Midpoint to nearest expressway/ramp centreline, capped at 1,500 m; farther means less traffic-pollution exposure

transit_connectivity.label: Subway entrances within 400 m
transit_connectivity.method: Entrances with entry allowed within 400 m of the midpoint

transit_connectivity.label: Distance to nearest subway entrance
transit_connectivity.method: Midpoint to nearest entrance, capped at 1,500 m

source_labels.streets: NYC Street Centerline (LION), NYC DCP via ArcGIS
source_labels.trees: NYC Parks Forestry Tree Points (live inventory)

street_metadata.score_method: Dimension score = mean of its ranked sub-indicators, each a 0–100 percentile among Manhattan segments (ties take the lowest rank; "fewer is better" indicators reversed). N/A when no ranked sub-indicator is measurable. Overall = equal-weight mean of the available dimension scores; coverage = how many of 12 were available.
street_metadata.id_scheme: id = analysis segment ID: "MN-" + LION physicalid, with "-n" when several LION records share one physicalid (ordered by geometry). source_segment_id = LION physicalid; lion_part = part index of a multi-part LION record.
street_metadata.study_area: NYC Street Centerline, borocode 1 (Manhattan incl. Roosevelt & Randalls Is.); bridges, tunnels, ramps and ferry routes excluded
street_metadata.value: Scores are relative ranks within Manhattan, NOT calibrated experience scores.
